requirement_nodes.name: Confirm entity identity and filing calendar
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Select corporate duties only after verifying entity form. Delaware corporations and LLCs have different filing regimes. FinCEN currently exempts US-created entities from BOI reporting; do not create a blanket BOI filing task.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US-DE.
Proposed review actions:
- Attach formation and current standing evidence, agent details and the actual contracting entity.
- After form/tax-year review, enter supported filing dates and receipts. Review foreign registrations and governance approvals separately.
Sources:
urn:legal-os:business-confirmation:fsp-delaware-scope (checked 2026-10-05)
https://corp.delaware.gov/paytaxes/ (checked 2026-10-05)
https://corp.delaware.gov/alt-entitytaxinstructions/ (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.fincen.gov/news/news-releases/fincen-removes-beneficial-ownership-reporting-requirements-us-companies-and-us (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Determine Delaware privacy applicability
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Current coverage tests include 35,000 consumers, excluding payment-only data, or 10,000 consumers plus more than 20% of gross revenue from data sales. Business/targeting nexus and exclusions also matter.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US-DE.
Proposed review actions:
- Produce an aggregated preceding-year Delaware scope calculation with provenance.
- If covered, map notice, rights, sensitive-data, opt-out and assessment duties to tested controls.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/schemas/countryCurrencyMap.js#L8 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://delcode.delaware.gov/title6/c012d/index.html (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Determine CCPA applicability and rights
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Review CCPA business criteria and exceptions. The adjusted revenue threshold is $26,625,000 from 1 January 2025; alternative consumer/household and sale/sharing tests still require assessment.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US-CA.
Proposed review actions:
- Record California scope evidence without exporting user records into Legal OS.
- If covered, assess notices, access/delete/correct, sale/sharing opt-out, sensitive-data limits and request handling.
Sources:
https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/ccpa (checked 2026-10-05)
https://cppa.ca.gov/announcements/2024/20241217.html (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Build the remaining US state privacy matrix
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Scope laws using actual resident and operating facts. Texas is a separate screening example; the first feed does not establish complete coverage of every US state.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US, states to confirm.
Proposed review actions:
- Obtain aggregated jurisdiction counts and an actual market list.
- Add a separately sourced, dated rule for each relevant state, including small-business and sensitive-data exceptions; record unresolved jurisdictions.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/schemas/countryCurrencyMap.js#L8 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.texasattorneygeneral.gov/consumer-protection/file-consumer-complaint/consumer-privacy-rights (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Review COPPA scope and age assurance
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Under-13 child-directed or actual-knowledge collection must be assessed separately from teen access. The amended rule became effective 23 June 2025, with general compliance required by 22 April 2026. An age-gate statement alone is insufficient.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US.
Proposed review actions:
- Test data collection before age capture, under-13 rejection, known-child escalation and third-party tracking.
- If covered, review parental notice/consent, disclosure consent, security, retention and parent rights against the amended rule.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/users.js#L265 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/settlement/guardianPortal.js#L35 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/complying-coppa-frequently-asked-questions (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-04-22/html/2025-05904.htm (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Review teen privacy and guardian safeguards
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Teen protection has different triggers from COPPA. The current Delaware text addresses consent for targeted advertising and data sales for known 13-17-year-olds when the Act applies.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US-DE and other confirmed teen jurisdictions.
Proposed review actions:
- Test guardian verification and privacy defaults across profile, video, payouts and ad paths.
- Document applicable teen-specific rules by actual jurisdiction and retain the evidence supporting age treatment.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/users.js#L265 (checked 2026-10-05)

https://delcode.delaware.gov/title6/c012d/index.html (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Assess EU and UK market obligations
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
GDPR Article 3 considers establishment, offering goods/services and monitoring behavior. If engaged, assess lawful bases, notices, rights, children, security, representatives and transfers. UK scope and current amendments need a separate legal decision.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: EU / UK, conditional.
Proposed review actions:
- Confirm actual EU/UK targeting, establishments and monitoring, not just country-menu availability.
- Prepare the processing record and a jurisdiction-specific applicability decision before approving EU/UK coverage.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/schemas/countryCurrencyMap.js#L8 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng (checked 2026-10-05)
https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/cookies-and-similar-technologies/ (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Verify advertising consent and preference enforcement
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Source-only privacy toggles and analytics identifiers justify a priority investigation. Applicable consent, opt-out and exemption rules depend on the technology, location, audience and processing purpose. No transmission or violation is presumed.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: UK / EU / relevant US states.
Proposed review actions:
- Capture a consent-by-age-and-country test matrix and sanitized network evidence before/after consent and withdrawal.
- Check GTM/Clarity fields, email fallback, tags, server ad eligibility and persisted preferences; block unsupported disclosures where the review confirms a gap.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/designer-spa/src/fsp-core/controllers/0002w-fsp-analytics.js#L1 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/designer-spa/src/fsp-core/controllers/0434-script-s53-69-browse-arenas-55.js#L31 (checked 2026-10-05)

https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/cookies-and-similar-technologies/ (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Prove access, export, deletion and appeal handling
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
The refreshed player export handler is locked and a settings deletion button displays a toast. Confirm live wiring and manual channels before concluding that a right is unavailable.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: Applicable user jurisdictions.
Proposed review actions:
- Run an authorized synthetic request through intake, verification, search, export/deletion, exceptions, response and appeal.
- Define law-specific deadlines only after coverage is approved; retain delivery and exception evidence.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/accountDataRequests.js#L31 (checked 2026-10-05)

https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/ccpa (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Approve a category-specific retention schedule
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
GDPR storage limitation is conditional on scope. Proposed governance work should distinguish videos, identity checks, logs, consents, payments, backups and legal holds. Source comments are not authority for universal retention.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: Applicable privacy and records jurisdictions.
Proposed review actions:
- Inventory data classes, purposes, legal bases and locations; obtain a supported duration per class.
- Verify disposal and legal-hold exceptions across primary stores, backups and processors, with minimal retained deletion evidence.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/services/accountLifecycleService.js#L41 (checked 2026-10-05)

https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/protecting-personal-information-guide-business (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Review vendors, processors and international transfers
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Executed commitments and applicable transfer law must be established. Source references to Stripe, analytics and hosting do not prove reviewed data-processing terms or authorized transfers.
Basis: CONTRACT. Jurisdiction: Vendor and data-flow jurisdictions.
Proposed review actions:
- Create a vendor register with role, data categories, region, subprocessors and contract evidence.
- Review processor clauses, access, onward transfers, incident notice, deletion and audit rights against the applicable legal regime.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/services/stripe.js#L201 (checked 2026-10-05)

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Assess Washington consumer health data
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Nutrition, fitness measurements or inferences may need review under Washington My Health My Data. Coverage depends on the statutory data and business definitions, not on whether the product is called a health app.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US-WA.
Proposed review actions:
- Confirm feature activation, data/inference categories and Washington nexus.
- If covered, review separate health-data notice, consent, sharing/sale, deletion, processor and security controls.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/nutrition.js#L1 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=19.373&full=true (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Resolve HIPAA role before making claims
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Fitness and nutrition functionality alone does not establish HIPAA coverage. Determine whether FSP acts as a covered entity or business associate for a covered relationship.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US.
Proposed review actions:
- Map each health relationship and contract; use HHS app scenarios to document the role decision.
- Require any relevant BAA and controls before promising HIPAA compliance; record a reasoned exclusion if appropriate.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/nutrition.js#L1 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/special-topics/health-apps/index.html (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Assess FTC health breach notification coverage
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
The FTC rule covers specified PHR vendors, related entities and service providers outside or alongside certain HIPAA relationships. Technical capacity to draw identifiable health information from multiple sources is a key fact.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US.
Proposed review actions:
- Document PHR classification, data sources and sharing authorizations.
- If covered, add the rule-specific discovery, recipient, timing and content requirements to the incident procedure, including unauthorized disclosures.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/nutrition.js#L1 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/complying-ftcs-health-breach-notification-rule-0 (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Determine biometric and identity-data obligations
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Ordinary video, pose scoring and document checks do not by themselves establish regulated biometric processing. Illinois section 15 warrants review if qualifying biometric identifiers/information are collected or possessed.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US-IL and other confirmed jurisdictions.
Proposed review actions:
- Obtain vendor data-flow and retention specifications, including templates and what FSP can access.
- If triggered, review notice, written release, published retention/destruction policy, disclosure limits and safeguards; verify the full current act first.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/services/stripe.js#L201 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/designer-spa/src/fsp-core/controllers/0627-showtakechallenge.js#L182 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.ilga.gov/legislation/ilcs/fulltext?DocName=074000140K15 (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Classify each paid contest, draw and prize
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
A state list in code is not legal clearance. Florida section 849.094 illustrates a specific promotion regime; it does not validate all FSP sports contests, draws or entry-fee models.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: Participant states/countries to confirm.
Proposed review actions:
- Prepare a mechanics sheet per format covering consideration, chance/skill, prizes, eligibility and actual locations.
- Obtain jurisdiction-specific classification and official rules, including promotion registration/bonding or restrictions where relevant, before enabling unapproved formats.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/settlement/payments.js#L90 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/settlement/geofence.js#L8 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/goldenTicketDrawEntries.js#L1 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0800-0899/0849/Sections/0849.094.html (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Obtain processor acceptance for competition payments
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Stripe lists prize-bearing games of chance, skill competitions and certain entry fees under prohibited gambling activities. The actual account, product and any written provider acceptance require review. A successful payment integration is insufficient.
Basis: PROCESSOR. Jurisdiction: Stripe account country and product.
Proposed review actions:
- Present accurate mechanics and flow of funds to the processor and retain its written classification.
- Verify permitted products and connected-account responsibilities before live collection; stop relying on test-mode success as approval.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/settlement/payments.js#L90 (checked 2026-10-05)

https://stripe.com/legal/restricted-businesses (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Classify wallet custody, transfers and redemption
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Money-transmission or stored-value analysis needs actual funds flow and redemption facts. FSP Bucks code is not proof of cash custody, cryptocurrency activity or a licensing exemption.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US federal/state and operating countries.
Proposed review actions:
- Diagram legal ownership and movement of funds, liability, balances, refunds and cash-out.
- Obtain financial-regulatory review for the exact model and jurisdictions; document any licensing or exemption basis without inferring it from Stripe usage.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/wallet.js#L53 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/payouts.js#L392 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.fincen.gov/resources/money-services-business-msb-registration (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Map prize, creator and payment tax reporting
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Prizes, service compensation and processor settlement may follow different reporting paths. Current tax year, payer, recipient and reporting allocation must be established before setting forms or thresholds.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US federal/state and recipient countries.
Proposed review actions:
- Obtain tax-adviser classification of each payment stream, W-9/W-8 requirements, withholding and actual tax-year thresholds.
- Reconcile processor versus platform reporting, retain filing receipts and assess relevant sales/VAT/GST nexus separately.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/settlement/payments.js#L90 (checked 2026-10-05)

https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-1099-misc (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.irs.gov/businesses/understanding-your-form-1099-k (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Reconcile consumer terms, privacy promises and refunds
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
FTC unfair/deceptive-practice principles make accurate product promises a priority. Public terms and privacy links could not be retrieved in this check, so their content is unverified rather than presumed absent.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: Consumer markets to confirm.
Proposed review actions:
- Retrieve approved published versions and reconcile seller identity, fees, refunds, prize terms, safety and privacy representations with actual operations.
- Verify notice accessibility and versioned assent; review country-specific consumer rights and dispute provisions.
Sources:
https://futureofsports.io/privacy (checked 2026-10-05)
https://futureofsports.io/terms (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/settlement/payments.js#L90 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/statutes/federal-trade-commission-act (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Screen any recurring subscriptions or trials
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Recurring subscriptions were not established in this source review. If offered, assess ROSCA disclosure, informed consent and cancellation requirements plus applicable state renewal rules. No vacated or proposed click-to-cancel rule is assumed operative.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US and other confirmed subscription markets.
Proposed review actions:
- Confirm whether any product renews or charges after a trial.
- If yes, test billing consent, renewal disclosures, cancellation and refunds end to end and obtain state-specific review.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/settlement/payments.js#L90 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/statutes/restore-online-shoppers-confidence-act (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Review user-content rights and takedown handling
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Video uploads need an evidence-based rights review. Section 512 safe harbors are conditional protections with specific requirements, not an automatic platform entitlement.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US and content markets.
Proposed review actions:
- Review upload licenses, music/third-party rights, participant and guardian publicity permissions, creator contracts and permitted reuse.
- If relying on a US safe harbor, assess eligibility, designated agent, notice/counter-notice and repeat-infringer process; retain implementation evidence.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/designer-spa/src/fsp-core/controllers/0627-showtakechallenge.js#L182 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.copyright.gov/what-is-copyright/ (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.copyright.gov/512/ (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Review child access, reporting and moderation duties
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
If FSP is an in-scope UK user-to-user service likely accessed by children, Ofcom describes access/risk assessments, protections and review records. Source report handlers alone do not establish effective moderation.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: UK, conditional; other markets require separate review.
Proposed review actions:
- Determine scope and actual UK links, then assess child access and service/content risks where required.
- Test reporting, blocking, escalation, response and appeal; separately obtain jurisdiction-specific child-safety and mandatory-reporting advice.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/cloud/lib/handlers/users.js#L265 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/designer-spa/src/fsp-core/controllers/0434-script-s53-69-browse-arenas-55.js#L31 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/designer-spa/src/fsp-core/controllers/0627-showtakechallenge.js#L182 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.ofcom.org.uk/online-safety/protecting-children/protection-of-children-duties-under-the-online-safety-act (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Review physical challenge safety and waivers
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
Proposed safety review for sports challenges and filming. This is a risk-management control, not a claim that one universal waiver or statutory safety standard applies.
Basis: ASSURANCE. Jurisdiction: Competition and venue locations.
Proposed review actions:
- Assess injury-prone challenges, age suitability, filming/location safety, escalation and emergency contacts.
- Review venue/coach responsibilities, insurance, guardian permissions and local waiver enforceability; do not treat a waiver as proof of safe design.
Sources:
https://github.com/FutureOfSports/d_zero/blob/967d14f004fa5d090f409f24546c72ebf7b1b54d/packages/designer-spa/src/fsp-core/controllers/0627-showtakechallenge.js#L182 (checked 2026-10-05)
https://www.ofcom.org.uk/online-safety/protecting-children/protection-of-children-duties-under-the-online-safety-act (checked 2026-10-05)

requirement_nodes.name: Assess accessibility and verify critical journeys
requirement_nodes.description:
INITIAL REVIEW INVENTORY. No human applicability approval. Control implementation is not assessed.
DOJ guidance addresses accessible websites for covered entities. Legal scope and the applicable standard require review; public-sector technical rules are not automatically the rule for every private app.
Basis: LAW. Jurisdiction: US and other served markets.
Proposed review actions:
- Review applicable accessibility obligations and contractual promises.
- Test signup, guardian, challenge/video, payments, privacy rights and support with keyboard and assistive technology; record fixes and acceptance evidence.
